No draws yet. The app needs the history of past draws (11 different numbers from 1 to 22 per draw). There are three ways to add it:

1. Add today’s draw – enter a draw by hand: tap the 11 numbers or type them.
2. Import CSV / XML with a CSV, TSV or TXT file – one draw per line, any delimiter (comma, semicolon, tab, | or spaces), dates in most common formats.
3. Import CSV / XML with an XML file – one element per draw, e.g. <draw date="2026-10-16" numbers="1 4 7 …"/>.

Files up to 25 MB are accepted. Rows without a date can be imported too (they become consecutive days).

CSPRNG Predictor %1$s

What it does: you feed it the past results of a daily "pick 11 numbers out of 1..22" draw (CSV / XML import or manual entry). It predicts the 11 numbers of the next draw, and when you add the real draw it scores the prediction it showed you and adapts its model for the following day.

Honesty note: a true CSPRNG (cryptographically secure random number generator) has no exploitable pattern. Over many draws the model’s average hit count is therefore expected to stay near the random baseline of 5.5 / 11. The app measures and displays this (Stats & accuracy) so you can see for yourself whether the source behaves randomly.

File formats: CSV / TSV / TXT with one draw per line, e.g. "2026-10-16,1,3,7,8,9,13,14,16,17,18,20" (header lines are skipped; delimiters , ; tab | or spaces; dates such as 2026-10-16, 16.10.2026, 10/16/2026 or 20261016). XML with one element per draw, e.g. <draw date="2026-10-16" numbers="1 3 7 …"/> or <draw><date>…</date><n>1</n>…</draw>. Rows without dates are treated as consecutive daily draws.

How it learns: nine simple experts (frequency, hot numbers, gaps, transitions, pairs, …) are mixed with weights that follow their past accuracy, plus a small per-number correction. The model re-learns from the full history (up to the most recent 20,000 draws) each time the data changes (walk-forward replay), so corrections, deletions and back-filled draws are always reflected consistently.

Your data stays on this device. The app needs no permissions and never goes online.
